description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用多元教學活動，協助學生運用語言學習策略，討論教材之議題，以達成以下目標：培養基礎英文書寫能力，深化英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的技能，並學習理解他人觀點及感受。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels and uses a variety of teaching activities to help students apply language learning strategies, and discuss topics from their course materials in order to achieve the following learning objectives: develop basic English writing skills, deepen their English reading, speaking, and listening skills, and learn to understand the different viewpoints and feelings of others..

targets.describe_ch: 運用所學之學習策略，針對教材內容，有效地以外語表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通。
targets.describe_en: Students can apply learning strategies to effectively convey their opinions regarding the themes presented in learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
課堂規定 / Class Rules:
 
1. 繳交、上傳作業請務必準時， 一律不接受遲交或補交作業 (請假者請自行注意作業繳交日期)。
Please ensure to submit or upload your assignments on time. The instructor will not accept any late or makeup assignments, even in cases of absence. If you miss a class, please check and keep track of the assignment deadlines.
 
2. 點名時一次點兩節課，點名後才進教室者，該節將以曠課論，並請同學於課間自行找教師補點名，以銷掉第二節課之曠課記錄。
Be on time. You will be counted as absent if you are late for class and miss the roll call. Also, the instructor will mark your attendance status as absent for both classes. Therefore, remember to see the instructor during the recess to change your attendance status for the second period of class. If you are absent (including both excused and unexcused leaves) over 12 hours (including 12 hours), missing either midterm or final evaluation, you will fail the course.
 
 
3. 關於請假與曠課：
    • 缺課(包含請假和曠課)次數達12節或以上將無法通過此課程，課程成績以0分計。
      Missing 12 classes or more (including excused and unexcused absences) will automatically fail the course with a grade of zero.
    • 如需請假，學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
      Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.
 
4. 補考/補做練習一律從80分起扣。 
All scores for makeup quizzes or exercises start from a maximum of 80 points. In other words, the highest score you can achieve for a makeup quiz or exercise is 80, regardless of your performance. 
 
5. 申請課堂小考或練習補考/補做之規定：一學期最多可申請2次，有於系統請假者才可申請，遲到、曠課一律不接受補考或補做。 
Regarding makeup quizzes and exercises: You can take makeup quizzes or exercises up to two times per semester. However, this is conditional upon having an officially recorded leave of absence in the school system. In other words, if you miss a quiz or exercise due to tardiness or unexcused absence from class, you will not be eligible to take the makeup quiz or exercise. 

6. 申請課堂補考/補做請於原時間之一個禮拜內申請，逾時不接受補考/補做申請。 
If you wish to take a makeup quiz or exercise, please submit a request to the instructor within one week of the original quiz/exercise date. Any requests made after this period will not be accepted. 

7. 期中考和期末考一率不接受補考，除非為特殊原因並符合以下： 
• 於考試日期前至少2個禮拜事先告知授課教師 
• 需提供相關正式證明文件 (住院證明、手術證明、參賽證明等) 
• 經授課教師事先同意
• 如重大事件事發臨時，最晚在考試時間開始三日內告知，並提出相關正式證明文件
No makeup exams or presentations are allowed for the midterm or final unless there are special circumstances that meet the following conditions:
• The instructor has been informed at least two weeks prior to the exam or presentation date.
• Relevant official documentation can be provided (such as proof of hospitalization, surgery, competition participation, etc.);
• The instructor has approved the makeup exam or presentation in advance.
• If an emergency occurs, please notify us within three days of the exam/evaluation and provide the relevant official documentation. 
 
8.若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試開始的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late applications will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor.  
 
9. 考試請遵照學校之考場規定，若作弊者一律以0分計算並呈報學生獎懲委員會。 
Please follow the university's exam regulations. Any cheating will result in a score of zero for the exam, and such cases will be referred to the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee.

integrity.tpa_score_new:
課堂規定 / Class Rules:
 
1. 繳交、上傳作業請務必準時， 一律不接受遲交或補交作業 (請假者請自行注意作業繳交日期)。
Please ensure to submit or upload your assignments on time. The instructor will not accept any late or makeup assignments, even in cases of absence. If you miss a class, please check and keep track of the assignment deadlines.
 
2. 點名時一次點兩節課，點名後才進教室者，該節將以曠課論，並請同學於課間自行找教師補點名，以銷掉第二節課之曠課記錄。
Be on time. You will be counted as absent if you are late for class and miss the roll call. Also, the instructor will mark your attendance status as absent for both classes. Therefore, remember to see the instructor during the recess to change your attendance status for the second period of class. If you are absent (including both excused and unexcused leaves) over 12 hours (including 12 hours), missing either midterm or final evaluation, you will fail the course.
 
 
3. 關於請假與曠課：
    • 缺課(包含請假和曠課)次數達12節或以上將無法通過此課程，課程成績以0分計。
      Missing 12 classes or more (including excused and unexcused absences) will automatically fail the course with a grade of zero.
    • 如需請假，學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
      Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.
 
4. 補考/補做練習一律從80分起扣。 
All scores for makeup quizzes or exercises start from a maximum of 80 points. In other words, the highest score you can achieve for a makeup quiz or exercise is 80, regardless of your performance. 
 
5. 申請課堂小考或練習補考/補做之規定：一學期最多可申請2次，有於系統請假者才可申請，遲到、曠課一律不接受補考或補做。 
Regarding makeup quizzes and exercises: You can take makeup quizzes or exercises up to two times per semester. However, this is conditional upon having an officially recorded leave of absence in the school system. In other words, if you miss a quiz or exercise due to tardiness or unexcused absence from class, you will not be eligible to take the makeup quiz or exercise. 

6. 申請課堂補考/補做請於原時間之一個禮拜內申請，逾時不接受補考/補做申請。 
If you wish to take a makeup quiz or exercise, please submit a request to the instructor within one week of the original quiz/exercise date. Any requests made after this period will not be accepted. 

7. 期中考和期末考一率不接受補考，除非為特殊原因並符合以下： 
• 於考試日期前至少2個禮拜事先告知授課教師 
• 需提供相關正式證明文件 (住院證明、手術證明、參賽證明等) 
• 經授課教師事先同意
• 如重大事件事發臨時，最晚在考試時間開始三日內告知，並提出相關正式證明文件
No makeup exams or presentations are allowed for the midterm or final unless there are special circumstances that meet the following conditions:
• The instructor has been informed at least two weeks prior to the exam or presentation date.
• Relevant official documentation can be provided (such as proof of hospitalization, surgery, competition participation, etc.);
• The instructor has approved the makeup exam or presentation in advance.
• If an emergency occurs, please notify us within three days of the exam/evaluation and provide the relevant official documentation. 
 
8.若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試開始的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late applications will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor.  
 
9. 考試請遵照學校之考場規定，若作弊者一律以0分計算並呈報學生獎懲委員會。 
Please follow the university's exam regulations. Any cheating will result in a score of zero for the exam, and such cases will be referred to the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee.

policy.ais_meno:
1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data.學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。
  2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.抄襲：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
  3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
